content: Stack Exchange API: every response can carry a backoff field (seconds to wait before hitting the same method again); ignoring backoff leads to throttle violations and IP bans; >30 req/s per IP triggers temporary ban; keyless daily quota ~300, keyed 10k (quota_max/quota_remaining on every response); quota is IP-based for unauthenticated apps; backoff can appear on any method even trivial ones.
